description: Erection of a single storey rear extension following demolition of existing conservatory. Erection of a rear roof and a side roof extension, with one side window, one rear window and two front roof windows. Erection of a proposed outbuilding in rear garden.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the proposed rear and roof extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building except for the permitted alluminium fenstration.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation facing No 4 Thornbury Aveneue shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
Condition : 5 - The oubtuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 6 Thornbury Avenue TW7 4NQ.
Condition : 6 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
